text: FROM: Bill Lynch, Supervisor Records Management
Records in the following cartons are scheduled for disposal as of O1/91.
Please initial each line to indicate approval for disposal or attach an
explanation of why these records should not be disposed of. If you do not respond
within forty (40) calendar days from the date of this Notice, the Legal Department
will be contacted to verify that no disposal suspension exists for these records
and, if no, the records will then be disposed of:
I certify that the records I have approved for disposal on the attached have been
reviewed against all applicable Disposal Suspension Notices and that none of the
records are subject to Disposal Suspensions.
